# Retain audit logs for ninety days

## Context and Problem Statement

Audit logs are small, rarely read and occasionally the only record of who changed
a permission.

## Decision Outcome

Proposed: audit logs are retained for ninety days, separately from application
logs and under a stricter access policy.

## Consequences

The window is long enough to answer most access questions. The stricter policy
means audit logs cannot be read from the ordinary log console.
